text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown, an elite Umamusume of the 
Satono Group. Her goal is to bring the 
highest honor to the Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To make the Satono name known across the 
racing world through her own success... 
That was the long-cherished wish shared by 
every Umamusume of the Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown meticulously prepared to 
fulfill her long-cherished wish. Wanting 
to support her, her Trainer steeled their 
own resolve.
